title: Customer Operations & Writing Specialist
description:
Here at Clerky, we build software to make legal paperwork easier for startups and their attorneys. We're profitable and growing sustainably. We're the most popular way for high-growth technology startups to form, and are also used by many top-tier startups for hiring and fundraising.

 

As a Customer Operations & Writing Specialist at Clerky, you will be the voice of the company to thousands of startup founders, investors, and attorneys. These customers use Clerky to get critical legal paperwork done, often on a tight timeline. Our success is based on word-of-mouth, so we have a strong culture of providing world-class service (ask us about our satisfaction ratings!). We are rabidly customer-centric.

 

What Makes Customer Operations Different at Clerky

 

It’s a lot harder here. Helping our customers can be unusually challenging due to the nuanced and specialized nature of their questions. Doing the job well can require a lot of iterative feedback, so we're looking for someone who thinks critically about their writing and is always looking for ways to improve. Along the way, you'll also pick up a lot of knowledge about startups and startup law.

 

The challenges never stop. The level of learning and craftsmanship that goes into writing responses to our customers requires intense focus. If you’re looking for the kind of position where you can easily master all the information at the beginning and work in a way that does not require intense focus, this position will probably not be a good fit for you. On the other hand, if you love learning and constantly challenging yourself, this position could be a good fit for you.

 

There are often no right answers. We’re often not able to provide definitive answers to the questions we receive. In many cases, the best we can do is to equip our customers with the information they need to be able to figure out the right answer on their own, or to understand that it isn’t possible to figure out what the right answer is. If you prefer an environment more oriented around providing definitive answers, this position may not be a good fit for you.

Minimum Requirements

  • Genuine love for helping people

  • High emotional intelligence

  • Logical / analytical thinker

  • Exceptional written English communication skills, including the ability to write precisely and succinctly

  • Extremely detail-oriented

  • Comfort with working remotely and independently

  • Technologically savvy - you should be confident in your ability to use new software without training

  • Appreciation for giving and receiving feedback often (often several times a day)

  • Natural internal motivation to constantly strive for excellence in everything you do

How We Work

  • Clerky has been remote-first for many years, long before COVID. We’re very familiar with working remotely, and enjoy it.

  • Our team is small, so everyone's contributions matter. We work efficiently, autonomously, and with great respect for each other.

  • We work openly and collaboratively. We’re here to support you in being successful in this role. You'll work closely with other team members to ensure our customers are getting the best possible support and experience.

  • Everyone on our team works hard, and we trust team members to know what will help them be most productive. Schedules are flexible as long as there is adequate team coverage.

  • We want to help you grow, so we have a budget for books, courses, tools, or whatever other educational resources you need to be successful.

  • We offer top-of-market compensation and benefits and the opportunity to learn a lot while helping our customers through an exciting time in their lives.

Responsibilities

  • Writing thoughtful and empathetic replies to customer emails using our help desk software, Help Scout

  • Writing and maintaining help center articles, and identifying topics for new articles based on customer inquiries

  • Working with our engineering team to debug software issues our customers encounter

  • Using our software to develop and manage new ways for our customers to complete legal paperwork

  • Assisting product team by testing new features and bug fixes, and conveying customer feedback

  • Spotting trends in customer issues that other team members should be alerted to

This is a 100% remote position. You'll be able to work from home (or from anywhere else). We offer top-of-market compensation and benefits, reasonable hours, and reasonable customers. No legal experience or background is necessary or preferred.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Communications Manager
description:
About Lemon.io
Lemon.io is building the autopilot for hiring. 
We've replaced the slow, expensive recruiting agency with a platform that delivers vetted, responsive candidates, ready for a final interview. In days, not weeks. 
Hundreds of fast-growing companies use Lemon to build their engineering teams, from early-stage startups to enterprises. We're profitable, bootstrapped, and growing at a moment when the legacy recruiting industry is being rewritten in real time.

Here's why this role exists. We have a great story and almost no one telling it. A profitable company helping rewrite a huge industry with AI, and a voice that is still a blank canvas. You'd be the one who decides how Lemon sounds and makes the market pay attention, working directly with the founder, with the freedom that comes from being bootstrapped.

About the position
The Communications Manager will own Lemon's external voice and its distribution.
The goal: make Lemon impossible to ignore in the engineering-hiring conversation. Every day, something from Lemon should be visible where our buyers and candidates already are, until the market treats us as the category leader.
This is a senior IC role, reporting directly to the founder. You'll personally do most of the writing and build systems for distribution.
This is an intensive role. You'll be producing daily and running a content distribution engine that doesn't stop. And while we'd typically expect 4+ years of experience, we're genuinely open to less experienced candidates who can demonstrate exceptional writing and judgment.

Responsibilities:
1. Executive Communications
- Lead the creation and execution of founders' personal brand platforms
- Produce and distribute day-to-day content across founders' channels
- Support founders' earned media: podcasts, panels, op-eds, and speaking opportunities
2. Internal News Scouting and Narrative Development
- Sit in product, customer success, sales, and ops syncs to identify newsworthy stories
- Identify and shape company moments worth telling publicly
- Translate internal milestones, launches, learnings, and customer wins into external content
- Distribute content via social and traditional media.
3. Team Engagement
- Build and support an internal content program that engages employees across functions
- Equip team members to share their work publicly through ready-to-use content and templates
- Coordinate the team's participation in industry conversations across channels
4. Monitoring, Automation
- Build and maintain content and distribution workflows using AI tools
- Set up monitoring for brand mentions, press coverage, and audience growth across channels
- Track, grow and report on key communications metrics quarterly

What we're looking for:
- Native or fluent English with cultural fluency for the US tech audience
- A genuinely strong writer. 
- You've been the voice behind someone else's posts. 
- Track record telling the story of a company, a product, or a movement
- Background in technology, B2B software, talent, recruiting, dev tools, or adjacent industries.
- You’re deeply immersed in the world of independent media: Substackers, podcasters, influencers on X or LinkedIn. 
- AI is already part of how you work.
- Comfortable operating in areas of genuine uncertainty.
- Results-oriented, with a bias toward action and impact.
- Want to be part of a small, fast-paced, and impactful team.

What success looks like in the first 4 weeks:
- You've built systems to capture content from our team and product, and to manufacture news.
- You've launched an amplification program by the team and outside voices, so every message travels.
- A repurposing workflow exists: one idea becomes a post, a thread, a clip, a newsletter line, without starting over each time.
- You've identified the 3 to 5 narratives that everyone will repeat.
- You've identified a few internal voices and enabled them to post regularly, with systems that feed them content ideas.
- By week 4, the founder's social posts go out 4 to 5 times a week.
- Baseline metrics captured, so growth is measurable from a known starting point.
Application Process

To apply, send us:
- Three writing samples that show range. At least one should be in a voice that isn't yours: something you ghost-wrote for an executive, a founder, or another public-facing operator.  
- A short note (200 words or fewer) telling us why this role and what you'd want to ship in your first 90 days. The point isn't to summarize your resume. It's to give us a sense of how you think and what you'd actually do.

What to expect:
- Application review within 7 days
- 45-minute call with the hiring team
- Paid trial project (up to 10 hours)
- Final 60-minute conversation with the founder
- Reference checks and offer

We aim to move from application to offer within 3-4 weeks.

title: Video Editor Reacts
location: Greenville, Greenville, North Carolina, United States
description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

About the Role

MrBeast is looking for a data-driven, creative, and fast-paced Video Editor to join our Content & Post-Production team working on the MrBeast Reacts channel. This role is for a master-level editor who lives and breathes YouTube culture, capable of transforming raw multi-cam reaction feeds into hyper-engaging content that keeps millions of viewers locked in. You will thrive in a high-feedback environment, balancing aggressive production schedules with a relentless obsession for frame-by-frame pacing and audience retention.

What You'll Do
  • Cut and assemble raw multi-cam reaction footage, seamlessly balancing primary talent commentary, PIP source media, and visual punch-ins.
  • Engineer high-retention video intros and hooks that immediately fulfill title and thumbnail promises within the first 30 seconds.
  • Execute hyper-fast pacing, comedic timing, and visual pop-ups, including kinetic typography, memes, and custom tracking graphics.
  • Perform high-quality sound design, including impactful SFX, dynamic music ducking, and precise audio balancing for voice clarity.
  • Collaborate closely with Lead Editors and creative teams to incorporate rapid turnaround notes and feedback loops.
  • Analyze YouTube retention curves alongside lead editors to pinpoint drop-off moments and refine pacing rules for subsequent edits.
  • Maintain clean, highly organized timeline projects in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, adhering to internal post-production standards.
  • Coordinate with the thumbnail team to ensure visual assets and key video climaxes align perfectly with channel creative strategy.
  • Stay ahead of internet culture and viral editing meta to continuously inject fresh humor and visual variety into channel content.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

ROAR is redefining hydration for a new generation. In a category that has become overly serious and hardcore performance obsessed, ROAR stands for something different: hydration that is expressive, effortless, and rooted in real life. Built for people who move, connect, and live life out loud, ROAR delivers complete hydration with vitamins, antioxidants, and electrolytes - all with just 20 calories and 3g of sugar or less per bottle.


More than a beverage, ROAR is a cultural signal - bright, approachable, and fun. It rejects the intensity and rules of traditional hydration in favor of something more human: joy, spontaneity, and the kind of movement that doesnât need a scoreboard. This positioning has resonated with consumers and retailers alike driving strong momentum across both natural and conventional retail, where ROAR continues to expand rapidly and now ranks as the #2 brand in the natural channel within the enhanced water category.

title: Sales & Marketing Director
location: Madrid, Madrid, Comunidad de Madrid, EspaÃ±a
description:
The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.

This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.

During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.

The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.

About The Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

General Responsibilities

  • Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
  • Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
  • Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
  • Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
  • Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
  • Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
  • Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
  • Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
  • Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
  • Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
  • Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
  • Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
  • Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
  • Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
  • Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
  • Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
  • Directly reporting to Company Leadership

Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.

You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.

You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.

The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Key Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience leading Sales, Marketing, or Revenue functions with direct ownership of commercial results
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to personally drive revenue growth while also developing scalable commercial systems and processes
  • Significant experience working within a digital marketing agency or SaaS company serving ecommerce businesses (required)
  • Proven success generating qualified leads through multiple acquisition channels including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Strong sales experience with a proven track record of personally closing new business and managing high-value sales opportunities
  • Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment
  • Experience selling retention marketing services such as Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, or UGC services is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, ecommerce marketing technology, and the broader ecommerce ecosystem is highly desirable
  • Existing relationships or network within the ecommerce or DTC industry is considered a strong advantage
  • Must possess excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer capable of attending virtual meetings
  • Must be open to receiving constructive feedback while also providing effective coaching and feedback to team members

About CertifyOS

CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.

Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. Weâre solving that problem.

Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.

Our vision is simple: One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.

Weâre backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. Weâre building a high-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.

About the Role:

As an Intern Machine Learning Engineer on a 6-month contract, you will help build, test, and deploy ML-powered services on our provider data platform. This is not a pure research role; the focus is on strong software engineering, testing, and robust evaluation rather than novel model architectures.

You will own features end-to-end by collaborating with stakeholders, implementing production-ready code, designing evaluation pipelines, and deploying services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a fully remote position.

What Youâll Do:

Design, implement, and maintain ML-driven services and data workflows in Python.

Apply software engineering best practices, including clean code, testing (unit and integration), code reviews, CI/CD, observability, and documentation.

Build and maintain evaluation pipelines and metrics to measure model and system performance in production-like environments.

Deploy and operate ML services on GCP, including tools such as Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, and Cloud Storage.

Troubleshoot and improve existing ML services with a focus on reliability, latency, and correctness.

Collaborate proactively with internal stakeholders across product, operations, engineering, and data teams to clarify requirements and iterate on solutions.

title: Human Resources Benefits Coordinator
description:
We are seeking an experienced HR Benefits Lead to own and enhance our employee benefits function while helping build the infrastructure for a scalable, high-performing benefits team. This individual will serve as the subject matter expert for all aspects of benefits administration, ensuring compliance, improving employee experience, and partnering closely with internal stakeholders and external vendors.


This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex programs, improving existing processes, and creating a best-in-class benefits function.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end administration of employee benefits programs across a multi-state workforce spanning more than 30 states.
  • Manage all health and welfare programs, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and voluntary benefits.
  • Own the administration of the company's 401(k) plan, ensuring timely and accurate retirement plan administration, non-discrimination testing, audits, and regulatory compliance.
  • Partner closely with payroll to ensure accurate deductions, benefit enrollments, qualifying life events, and reconciliation of benefit data.
  • Oversee leave administration, including FMLA, ADA accommodations, short-term disability, long-term disability, and applicable state leave program
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations governing employee benefits across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Build strong relationships with insurance brokers, retirement plan advisors, and third-party administrators to negotiate plan design, control costs, and improve service levels.
  • Analyze benefit utilization, market trends, and employee feedback to recommend enhancements to benefit offerings.
  • Translate complex benefit plans into clear, employee-friendly communications that help employees make informed enrollment decisions.
  • Develop scalable processes, documentation, and internal controls to support future team growth.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employee benefit questions and escalated issues.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive HR benefits experience with ownership of end-to-end benefits administration.
  • Experience supporting a multi-state employee population across 30 or more states.
  • Deep knowledge of medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and voluntary benefit plans.
  • Strong expertise in 401(k) administration, including retirement plan compliance, non-discrimination testing, annual reporting, and vendor management.
  • Demonstrated experience administering FMLA, ADA, short-term disability, long-term disability, and state leave progra
  • Strong understanding of ERISA, COBRA, HIPAA, ACA, and other applicable benefits regulations.
  • Experience partnering closely with payroll to ensure accurate benefit processing and compliance.
  • Proven ability to establish and manage strategic relationships with insurance brokers and benefit providers while evaluating plan design and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex benefits information for employees and leadership.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.


Preferred Background

  • Experience stepping into an environment where benefits programs required stabilization and operational improvement.
  • Takes ownership of critical programs, particularly the company's 401(k), ensuring every aspect of retirement administration is accurate and compliant rather than simply processing transactions.
  • Comfortable bringing structure to under-managed programs and implementing sustainable processes.
  • Proven ability to influence brokers and insurance carriers on pricing, plan design, and service expectations.
  • Experience building or expanding an internal benefits function and mentoring future team members.

title: People Operations Manager
description:
Evio Overview

Evio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.

In 2020, a group of five amazing Blue Cross Blue Shield health plans that in total serve more than 20 million members recognized that the way medications get to patients needs significant reformârapidly rising costs and massive system complexities are detrimental to patients and the entire industry. In 2025, Wellmark joined as Evio's first non-founding investor and sixth owner health plan. Each company made, and continues to make, significant investments to establish Evio as an independent entity to lead this transformation. â¨

Evio has advancedâ¯analytics and contracting capabilities at scale, and a suite of digital tools, to power our high-cost medication solutions. Our solutions act as a self-reinforcing âflywheelâ where each element strengthens and feeds into the next, and support an âOnly Evio can do that,â mindset and prioritization.

Evio is also a company that has invested heavily in and been highly intentional about people, team and culture. We believe we have created a very special place to work and encourage candidates to observe and ask us about our culture and decide for themselves.

Evio's Values

  • Empathy â The people our business serves always come first. We care for our teammates and put ourselves in the shoes of our health plan customers and the patients and clinicians our solutions benefit.
  • Diversity â We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone belongs and is valued for their background, experience and insights â one that encourages diversity of ideas, and is a nurturing, trusting, and accepting place for all.
  • Adventure â We are flexible, thrive in ambiguity, fail fast, and pivot quickly to get to a better answer. We celebrate wins and pivots with equal intensity.
  • Relentless â Guided by evidence and data, we are creative, curious, and unwavering in our pursuit of challenging the status quo and each other.
  • Transparency â Just as we seek to bring transparency to the pharmacy supply chain, authenticity and integrity are core to the way we communicate.
  • Excellence â We strive to raise the bar in all we do by hiring and developing exceptional talent and holding ourselves and our thinking to the highest standard.

People Operations Manager

About The Role

As People Operations Manager, you'll execute the operational foundation of the teammate experience at Evio. Reporting to the Head of Evio Experience, you'll help ensure every stage of the teammate experience is thoughtful, well-executed, and compliant. Evio is a growing company with increasing teammate support needs. This is a hands-on role where you'll serve as Evio's subject matter expert on benefits, administer people operations, manage our people systems and vendor relationships, and ensure teammates receive timely, knowledgeable support throughout their time at Evio.

We're looking for someone with a service-oriented mindset who takes pride in delivering an exceptional teammate experience through operational excellence, responsiveness, and continuous improvement. Success in this role means teammates know they can count on you for accurate answers, thoughtful support, and reliable execution, while managers trust you to keep logistics running smoothly behind the scenes.

What You'll Do

Administer benefits and support teammates

  • Administer Evio's benefits programs, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), disability, COBRA, and other benefit offerings.
  • Become Evio's internal expert on benefit programs, providing timely, knowledgeable support to teammates and helping them navigate questions and life events.
  • Resolve benefit issues by partnering closely with teammates, brokers, carriers, and vendors.
  • Administer leaves of absence and workplace accommodations.
  • Manage relationships with benefits brokers, vendors, and other external partners.
  • Recommend improvements to benefits and people policies based on teammate feedback, operational insights, and evolving business needs.

Own people systems and operational excellence

  • Own the day-to-day administration of people systems, including Justworks and future people technology platforms.
  • Ensure people systems, teammate records, workflows, and documentation remain accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Document, maintain, and continuously improve people processes to support consistency and scale.
  • Maintain SOC-related people operations controls and documentation.
  • Identify practical opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational processes.

Support policies and compliance

  • Help maintain the teammate handbook and people policies.
  • Ensure required employment notices and documentation remain current.
  • Partner with Legal and the Head of Evio Experience to support employment law compliance.
  • Maintain documentation standards and consistent employment practices.
  • Help ensure leave, accommodation, and employment practices are administered consistently and compliantly.

Coordinate onboarding and offboarding

  • Execute the operational aspects of the teammate journey from pre-boarding through offboarding.
  • Coordinate pre-boarding logistics to ensure new teammates have a seamless start.
  • Manage offboarding processes, documentation, and logistics.
  • Administer company calendars, and recurring people operations processes.

Your Skills And Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in people operations, human resources, teammate experience, benefits administration, HR compliance, or a closely related operational role. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from a variety of backgrounds, provided they've demonstrated ownership of core people responsibilities such as benefits administration, people systems, HR compliance, and supporting the teammate lifecycle in a growing organization.
  • Strong experience administering employee benefits and supporting teammates through benefit questions, life events, and leave administration.
  • Experience managing people systems and maintaining accurate teammate records and workflows.
  • Experience managing relationships with external vendors, brokers, and service providers.
  • Working knowledge of human resources practices, employment law, HR compliance, accommodations, documentation standards, and leave administration.
  • Experience documenting and improving operational processes in a growing organization.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to explain complex information clearly and compassionately.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism.
  • A service-oriented mindset with a genuine desire to support teammates and help create a company and culture we're all proud to be part of.

Salary considerations

The anticipated salary range for this position is $100,000â$130,000 annually plus additional variable compensation.

Atâ¯Evio,â¯weâreâ¯committed to building a competitive compensation package to honor the value our teammates bring as well as attract andâ¯retainâ¯top talent that is aligned with our culture,â¯missionâ¯and values. Compensation includes base pay (range shown) and could include other variable compensation opportunitiesâ¯depending on job seniority, location, and date of hire.

Please note that the base pay information shown is a general guideline for the job responsibilities and qualifications listed. Salary decisions are based on candidateâ¯experience, andâ¯market and business considerations.â¯

Evio Benefits

Evio offers a number of attractive benefits to eligible teammates including health insurance, retirement savings, life and disability insurance, paid and unpaid time off, and other benefits to make sure Evio teammates and families are well supported.

  • Great Health Insurance The company pays 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for teammates, and 50% for dependents.
  • 401K Match Evio matches 100% of teammate contribution up to 5% of salary, subject to IRS limits.
  • Time Off We have a flexible vacation policy for teammates to unplug and recharge when you need it. There is no minimum or maximum amount of vacation allowed per year, and there is no payment in consideration for unused vacation. Vacation is to be used at your discretion, with approval of leadership.
  • Parental Leave Generous paid leave for new parents (includes birth and non-birth parents).

Fraud Notice

Weâve Recently Learned Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Falsely Claiming To Represent Evio. Protecting Our Candidates Is Incredibly Important To Us, And We Want To Share a Few Reminders

  • All official communication will come from an email ending in @evio.com.
  • We will never conduct text-only interviews (Teams, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.).
  • We will never ask for payment, gift cards, fees, or purchases of any kind.
  • We will never request sensitive financial information during the recruiting process.
  • Our open roles are posted only on our official website, LinkedIn, and Greenhouse job board.

If you believe youâve encountered a scam, you can also report it to the Federal Trade Commission or the Internet Crime Complaint Center. Thank you for your care and vigilance â weâre grateful to everyone who helps keep our community safe.

Information Disclosure

We value transparency in our hiring process and want applicants to understand how your information is used.

We collect and use personal information you provide during the application process such as your resume, employment history, education, interview responses, and other job-related information, to evaluate your qualifications for employment. This may also include limited technical and interaction data, such as IP address and device or browser information.

We may use automated or AI-assisted tools to help review applications, identify qualified candidates, and detect or investigate potentially fraudulent or deceptive activity. Human reviewers remain involved, and these tools support, not replace, human judgment.

These measures support a fair and secure hiring process for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please inform us when invited to interview.

California privacy noticeâ¨Consistent with California law, we use this information for recruiting, hiring, and related business purposes, including evaluating your candidacy and improving our hiring processes.

title: Brand Designer
location: New York, New York, New York, United States
description:
About Symbiotic

Symbiotic is the infrastructure beneath collateral markets, where capital can secure financial obligations, remain productive, and be enforced by code.

By changing the economics of onchain collateral, Symbiotic enables new categories of neofinance applications that were previously impossible to build - including credit, insurance, RWA liquidity, and more.

As institutional capital increasingly moves onchain, Symbiotic is positioned to become the coordination layer connecting capital and risk across the onchain economy.

Backed by Paradigm, Pantera, Cyber.fund, and Coinbase Ventures, we power 80+ vaults, 74,000+ active stakers, and 111 operators - with Chainlink, Nexus Mutual, and Cap Labs among the teams live in production.

See how Symbiotic is powering the next generation of onchain finance: symbiotic.fi

Our People

Weâre a tight-knit team of experienced builders working at the forefront of financial infrastructure. Our backgrounds span high-growth tech start-ups, leading crypto companies, major banks, insurers, and financial institutions. We work with ownership, a high bar for craft, and the urgency of an early-stage company - in an environment where people are trusted to take initiative and supported to do their best work.

Weâre looking for talented professionals to join us at a defining moment, as Symbiotic helps shape the next generation of onchain finance.

What You'll Do

  • Own visual output across brand, campaigns, web, social, and launch moments, from concept to shipped asset.
  • Turn complex financial infrastructure and products into things people can actually see and understand.
  • Set and hold the visual system as we scale, not just as a guideline doc, but as consistent, recognisable output across everything we ship.
  • Support event and content collateral: Prepares high-impact visuals for Web3 conferences, whitepaper illustrations, and blog graphics .
  • Optimize assets for Web3 platforms: Ensures designs are responsive for web3 wallets, mobile apps, and animated formats, while adhering to crypto-specific trends.
  • Produce motion and 3D work where it earns its place: product explainers, launch films, conference presence.

Who You Are

  • Fast and good, not one or the other. Most designers have one. You have both and you can walk us through the timeline on specific pieces in your portfolio: how long it took, what the deadline was, what you cut.
  • Deep in one or two areas, competent across the rest. Strong in brand or motion or 3D, able to hold your own in the others.
  • Self-directed. You've scoped, sequenced, and driven real projects without someone telling you the next step and made the calls yourself when the brief was ambiguous.
  • Someone who pitches rather than asks permission. You bring a direction and argue for it.
  • Unbothered by direct feedback. We're small, fast, and radically transparent with each other.
  • Sitting on a portfolio with real range. You shipped work, not concepts, ideally something you took from nothing to live under time pressure.

Nice to have

  • Crypto, fintech experience â enough that you're not learning what a protocol is on the job.
  • In-house experience at an early-stage company.
  • 3D or motion as a genuine strength rather than a passing familiarity.

description:
Transportation Analyst

Location: Charlotte, NC, USA, remote

Work Location: remote local

Have you ever enjoyed ArnoldÂ®, BrownberryÂ® or OroweatÂ® bread? A ThomasâÂ® English muffin or bagel? Or perhaps snacked on a Sara LeeÂ®, EntenmannâsÂ® or MarinelaÂ® cake or donut? If the answer is yes, then you know Bimbo Bakeries USA!

More than 20,000 associates in bakeries, sales centers, offices and on sales routes work to ensure our consumers have the freshest products at every meal. In addition to competitive pay and benefits, we provide a safe and inclusive work environment that appreciates diversity, promotes development and allows our associates to be their authentic selves.

## LI-NP1

Come join the largest baking company in the world and our family of 20,000 associates nationwide!

Top Reasons To Work At Bimbo Bakeries USA

Salary Range: $56,500 - $73,400

Annual Bonus Eligibility

Comprehensive Benefits Package

Paid Time Off

401k & Company Match

Position Summary:

The Transportation Analyst supports transportation planning, daily shipment execution, customer service, and performance reporting across the transportation network. This role combines analytical problem solving with service-oriented communication to improve shipment visibility, monitor on-time performance, support track-and-trace activity, identify trends and exceptions, and provide timely reporting and follow-up to carriers, internal stakeholders, and operations teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support transportation planning activities by reviewing shipment demand, routing requirements, carrier capacity, delivery schedules, and operational constraints.
  • Monitor shipment execution through track-and-trace activity, providing timely updates on shipment status, delivery expectations, appointment changes, and potential service risks.
  • Provide customer service support to carriers, internal teams, and business partners by responding to transportation inquiries, resolving shipment issues, and coordinating follow-up on exceptions.
  • Track, analyze, and report transportation KPIs including on-time pickup, on-time delivery, appointment adherence, shipment visibility, exception resolution time, carrier response time, and service issue trends.
  • Prepare on-time performance reporting and provide analysis on delays, missed appointments, late deliveries, root causes, and opportunities to improve service performance.
  • Analyze transportation data to identify trends, cost impacts, service gaps, network inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve planning, execution, and carrier performance.
  • Partner with Transportation, Planning, Logistics, Operations, Sales, Customer Service, and carrier partners to support daily execution, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Request, validate, and maintain accurate shipment, carrier, and transportation data to support reporting, performance analysis, and operational decision-making.
  • Review transportation reports and data for inconsistencies, missing information, shipment exceptions, and documentation gaps; seek clarification as needed to ensure accurate reporting and follow-up.
  • Assist with business cases, savings projections, operating budgets, and project start-ups by providing transportation data, KPI insights, and performance analysis.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying process gaps, recommending improvements, and helping standardize transportation planning, reporting, and communication processes.
  • Serve as cross-functional support for transportation planning and execution activities as needed to ensure operational continuity and consistent service levels.

Leadership Competencies

Education and Work History:

  • 3-5 yearsâ experience in Supply Chain/Transportation Analysis in CPG, Food Beverage or Third Party Logistics company.
  • Understanding of the North American transportation industry including dedicated/private fleet, TL, LTL (domestic and cross border), intermodal.
  • Highly proficient / advanced working knowledge in Microsoft Office (ie: Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, PowerPoint).
  • Experience/Exposure with logistics optimization tools (routing, transportation planning software) such as Appian, Paragon, JDA/Bule Yonder is a definite asset.
  • Working knowledge of TMS (Specially Oracle TMS) is an asset.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly.
  • Strong customer service mindset with the ability to support carrier partners, internal stakeholders, and operations teams by proactively addressing service issues, communicating changes, and coordinating resolution of transportation exceptions.
  • Ability to work with and support all team members, management and shareholders.

The physical and mental demands described in each job posting are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of each job. Reasonable accommodations may be requested to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of each job.

description:

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region â this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

Â 

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

Â 

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Â 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Poland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Poland.

Â 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Â 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: VP Revenue
location: New York, New York, New York, United States
description:
Mongoose is the leading AI Engagement Platform in higher education. Colleges and universities use us to increase enrollment, retention, and fundraising — without adding staff.


We have the product and the customers. What we don't have yet is a revenue engine to match. That's this role. As VP of Revenue, you own it end to end — new business, client success, account management, and, most importantly, the system that ties them together. Your job is to make it simple and run it with discipline.



What You'll Do


  • Own all of revenue. The whole revenue org reports to you — one team, one leader. New business, client success, and account management are the front line, with enablement and operations behind them — the training and tools that set them up to win. It all serves one goal: grow ARR — by winning new business and helping our customers succeed. So you're measured on two things: new ARR and gross retention.




  • Build a simple, repeatable selling system. One clear path from first call to close to renewal — the stages, standards, and playbooks the whole team runs the same way. Make it so clear that reps know what good looks like and spend their time selling, not guessing. Done right, it shows up in forecasts you can trust, faster deals, and better conversion at every step.




  • Grow the people who sell it. Our reps are early in their careers and hungry, so growing them isn't a side project — it's the job. You build the system that does it: ramp, enablement, and a steady coaching cadence. And you're in it, not above it — in the deals and the reviews, helping close and coaching the fundamentals in the moment, not from a slide at quarter's end. The result is reps who sell with real confidence and conviction: they know how to win, and they believe they will.




  • Move us up-market. Our next stage of growth is in bigger deals. You know where the real opportunity lives in higher ed, and you focus the team there — raising the ACV we pursue, building around the highest-value accounts, and growing the ones with real upside. It takes sharp market judgment, a head for the numbers, and the discipline to say no to deals that aren't worth the team's time.




  • Run revenue like an AI company. Most revenue orgs still operate the way they did decades ago — we won't. We sell AI for a living, and the whole company is getting far more efficient, accurate, and effective by letting AI do the manual work. That takes more than watching for the next AI tool — it takes imagination: you picture how technology could reinvent the work, then we build it.






What You'll Bring


  • You've run a full revenue org — new business and retention both — and carried a number yourself, not just managed people who carried theirs.




  • When a number gets missed, you go straight to the funnel math — pipeline, conversion, time-in-stage — not the story about why.




  • You've built a selling system that works — whether you stood it up from scratch or overhauled a broken one inside an established org.




  • You're a real coach. You've taken early-career reps and turned them into closers — hands-on, not from a dashboard.




  • You think in unit economics and read a market fast. You've moved a team toward bigger, better deals, and had the discipline to walk from the rest.




  • You're already using AI to reinvent how you work, and you don't wait for permission to push it further.




  • Higher ed or EdTech experience is a strong plus, not a must. The market has real nuance — if you haven't lived in it, show us how you'll close the gap fast.






How We WorkRevenue doesn't run in isolation. You're a key member of our senior leadership team — leading revenue alongside the CEO, partnering with Product and Marketing on go-to-market, and with Finance and People to run the business. Tight feedback loops, honest calls, shared decisions. We hold each other accountable to the plan — and to the whole outcome, not just our own lane.


More About Mongoose

1,000+ higher ed institutions already trust Mongoose — built to give their teams exponentially more capacity across the systems they already run.


AI handles the routine, so people can focus on the work that actually moves students forward — more applications completed, more students retained, more donors reached. Same team. Much bigger impact.



What We Offer

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401K with company match: 100% of the 1st 3% and 50% of the next 2%

  • Flexible PTO

  • Competitive Leave Policies

  • 13 paid holidays, including a week off between Christmas and New Year’s




The BasicsRemote, anywhere in the US. Some travel — for customers, for big deals, and for time together as a team.
 
At Mongoose, we believe that diversity drives innovation, and inclusion builds stronger teams. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know—we’re here to help.

description:

We are seeking an ambitious and commercially minded Junior Account Manager to join our Sales team and support the management of key national retail accounts. This role provides an excellent opportunity to develop a career in Account Management. You will work collaboratively with internal teams including Marketing, Category, Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Service, and Demand Planning to execute customer strategies, deliver business objectives, and support the continued growth of our wholesale retail partnerships.

  • Manage and control all promotion expenditure within your responsibility in line with the companyâs guidelines, to ensure an optimum return on investment.

description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.

About the company

Our client is a results-driven B2B growth agency that specializes in bridging the gap between brand awareness and sales conversions. Based in the UK with a global reach across major hubs like New York and Dublin, the team provides a sophisticated "go-to-market as a service" model. They integrate deep market research, creative brand positioning, and demand generation with high-performance SDR teams to build sustainable sales pipelines for scaling B2B businesses. By shifting away from traditional templated outreach, they focus on warming markets and earning prospect trust before a single call is made.

The team prides itself on an intelligence-first methodology, ensuring every campaign is backed by data and high-confidence market insights. Serving innovative founders in the SaaS, FinTech, and professional services sectors, they have a proven track record of generating millions in pipeline value. This is a collaborative, high-growth environment suited for professionals who value transparency, original research, and the pursuit of meaningful, high-quality sales outcomes over volume-based metrics.

We are looking for a high-energy, German-speaking Sales Development Representative to join a premier UK-based B2B lead generation agency. In this role, you wonât just be selling a service; you will be the engine behind the growth of B2B founders globally. This is an opportunity to join a fast-paced, global team where your performance directly impacts the companyâs expansion into the DACH market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Native-level fluency in German (written and spoken).

  • Experience in B2B Sales or Lead Generation.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
We are conducting a retained search for a Chief Operating Officer on behalf of a private equity-backed industrial services platform in a period of accelerated growth through acquisition and organic expansion. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the COO will hold enterprise-wide accountability for operational performance, integration execution, and the scalability of the operating model across a multi-site national footprint.

This is a succession-visible seat. The successful candidate will operate as the CEO's primary partner in translating the investment thesis into operational results, with regular exposure to the sponsor and the board.


Key Responsibilities Direct all field and corporate operations across the platform, owning performance against EBITDA, safety, and service-level commitments Lead post-acquisition integration, including operational diligence support, first-100-day execution, and synergy realization against underwriting assumptions Architect the operating infrastructure required to scale, including systems, standardized processes, and management cadence across sites Build, assess, and upgrade the operational leadership bench, from regional leaders to site general managers Partner with the CFO on capital deployment, margin improvement initiatives, and the operational inputs to board and lender reporting Represent operations in quarterly board sessions, owning the narrative on execution, risk, and value creation progress


What You Bring 20+ years of progressive operations leadership, including a prior COO, President, or equivalent enterprise operating role Full P&L accountability at $150M+ revenue scale across multi-site or multi-region operations Demonstrated success operating within a private equity hold period, including board and sponsor engagement A record of leading acquisition integration from close through synergy capture Undergraduate degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred

Compensation: $350K-$575K base, annual incentive, and meaningful equity participation

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
We are seeking a Social Media Strategist to build and grow a personality-led social media presence from the ground up.

This is a hands-on, end-to-end role covering strategy, account setup, content planning, production management, publishing, audience growth, community management, and performance optimization across Instagram and TikTok. You will work closely with the founder to establish a distinctive online identity and develop it into a recognizable, highly engaging social presence.

Responsibilities

  • Build and launch the Instagram and TikTok profiles from zero, including positioning, tone of voice, content pillars, visual direction, and channel strategy
  • Develop and execute the organic growth strategy, with a focus on reach, engagement, follower growth, and long-term audience development
  • Create viral campaign concepts, social-first stories, and repeatable content formats that establish a distinctive and recognizable online personality
  • Manage the full content lifecycle, including research, ideation, scripting, content calendars, production coordination, approvals, publishing, and optimization
  • Use platform analytics, audience insights, watch time, retention, and engagement data to guide creative decisions and improve performance
  • Manage day-to-day community engagement and coordinate with the founder and creative partners


Requirements

  • Proven experience launching and organically growing Instagram and TikTok accounts from an early or zero-follower stage
  • A strong portfolio of high-performing, viral, or culturally relevant social content supported by measurable growth results
  • Deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok algorithms, audience behavior, retention, discoverability, engagement, and organic growth mechanics
  • Strong creative strategy and social-first storytelling skills, with the ability to turn a personality into compelling and repeatable content
  • Hands-on experience managing social media end to end, from strategy and content development through production, publishing, analytics, and community management
  • Strong project management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with the founder and creative production partners
  • Able to work PST hours


Nice to Have

  • Experience working with creator-led brands, founders, entertainment properties, personality-driven accounts, legal brands, or character-led content is advantageous but not required

title: Career News: Enugu Governor Approves Recruitment of 6,580 Teachers, School Staff
description:
Information is Power! Get new Jobs in your EmailEnter your Email below and click Subscribe:
Subscribe
Enugu State Governor, Peter Mbah, has approved the recruitment of 6,580 qualified candidates into various academic, technical and administrative roles across public primary and junior secondary schools in the state, with a strong focus on staffing the state’s 267 Smart Green Schools.
This was contained in a job vacancy advertisement issued by the Executive Chairman of the Enugu State Universal Basic Education Board, Associate Professor Hyginus Okibe Banko.
In the vacancy notice by our correspondent on Wednesday, the board emphasised that the recruitment forms part of the state government’s broader education strategy.
“In line with his administration’s commitment to providing the human resources required to drive the Smart Green School initiative and deliver quality education across the state, Governor Peter Mbah has approved the recruitment,” the notice read.
According to the notice, the recruitment drive cuts across multiple core and specialised roles.
A breakdown of the positions shows that the board is seeking 4,698 core subject teachers in Mathematics, English Language, Basic Science, Basic Technology, ICT, French, Igbo Language and History.
Other positions advertised include 520 digital librarians, 380 experiential learning innovators, 267 guidance counsellors, 267 ICT staff, 267 laboratory attendants, 136 account officers and 45 technicians.
Outlining the educational and professional requirements, ENSUBEB stated that teaching applicants must possess a bachelor’s degree in education, a bachelor’s degree or Higher National Diploma with a Postgraduate Diploma in Education, or a Nigeria Certificate in Education in the relevant subject areas.
Registration with, or proof of ongoing registration with, the Teachers Registration Council of Nigeria is mandatory for teaching applicants.
Requirements for non-teaching roles vary, ranging from degrees in specialised fields such as Library and Information Science, STEM and Psychology to an Ordinary National Diploma, Trade Test Certificate or SSCE/WASSCE for positions such as laboratory attendants, technicians and ICT staff.
The board emphasised that “candidates applying with a degree or HND must possess a valid NYSC discharge or exemption certificate,” while noting that “practical proficiency in Information and Communication Technology (ICT) tools is required across all cadres.”
Interested and qualified candidates are required to submit a formal application letter alongside a detailed curriculum vitae, copies of credentials, a birth certificate or sworn affidavit of age, and valid contact information.
Applications can be submitted in hard copy to the Office of the Executive Chairman, ENSUBEB, Enugu State, or electronically by compiling all documents into a single PDF file and sending them to ensubebofficial@outlook.com.
Highlighting the rules governing the application process, the board added, “Important Note: Application is completely FREE OF CHARGE. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the screening and selection interview.”

title: Category Manager
description: Who We Are Moniepoint is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, empowering businesses and their customers with seamless payment, banking, credit, and management tools. In 2023, we processed $182 billion and are Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer. We are on a mission to create financial happiness for everyone, everywhere. What We Do At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About Moniebook The all-in-one business management software for retail and restaurant businesses. We sell, track inventory, manage bookkeeping, and accept payments — all from one platform. Offline-first, mobile-ready, and built for how Nigerian businesses actually operate. For more info: https://moniepoint.com/moniebook Job Title: Category Manager Location: Port Harcourt Work Mode: Hybrid Job Purpose The Category Manager serves as the primary trusted advisor and ongoing point of contact for Moniebook customers post-onboarding. This role is accountable for driving long-term customer satisfaction, retention, and growth by ensuring customers maximise value from the Moniebook solution, achieve their business objectives, and remain engaged, successful partners. Operating as a proactive customer advocate, you will own the customer relationship lifecycle, monitoring signals, conducting regular business reviews, identifying expansion opportunities, resolving issues, and driving feature adoption that deepens product stickiness. Success is measured by customer retention (churn prevention), Net Promoter Score (NPS), expansion revenue (upsell/cross-sell), and customer satisfaction (CSAT) scores. Key Responsibilities Customer Relationship Ownership: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts. Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders (business owners, managers, staff) through proactive communication, responsiveness, and genuine commitment to their success. Proactive Customer Engagement & Support: Regularly check in with customers to assess satisfaction, understand evolving needs, provide guidance on best practices, and address questions or concerns before they escalate. Be the first responder for customer queries and issues, delivering quick, efficient solutions. Adoption & Value Realization: Drive ongoing adoption of Moniebook features by educating customers on underutilised capabilities, sharing relevant use cases, and providing training refreshers. Monitor usage data to identify adoption gaps and proactively intervene to increase engagement and product stickiness. Customer Health Monitoring & Risk Management: Track customer health signals, including login frequency, transaction volume, support ticket trends, and feature adoption. Identify at-risk accounts showing signs of disengagement or dissatisfaction, and implement targeted retention strategies to prevent churn. Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs): Conduct structured business review sessions with customers to analyse their usage data, showcase ROI and value delivered, align on business goals, surface insights and recommendations, and co-create success plans for the upcoming period. Revenue Growth & Expansion: Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on customer needs, business growth, and product usage patterns. Collaborate with Sales to introduce additional features, premium tiers, or complementary products that drive incremental revenue and customer value. Issue Resolution & Escalation Management: Troubleshoot technical issues, configuration challenges, and operational questions. Coordinate with Product, Engineering, and Support teams to resolve complex issues while maintaining transparent communication with customers and managing their expectations throughout. Customer Advocacy & Voice-of-Customer: Serve as the internal voice of the customer by collecting and synthesising feedback, feature requests, pain points, and competitive insights. Share these with Product and Leadership teams to inform product roadmap decisions and business strategy. Renewal Management: Own the renewal process for assigned accounts, ensuring contracts are renewed on time with minimal friction. Proactively address renewal concerns, negotiate terms where appropriate, and secure long-term commitments that reflect the value delivered. Continuous Learning & Product Expertise: Develop and maintain deep expertise in Moniebook's product capabilities, retail industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer success best practices. Participate in team training, product updates, and AM strategy initiatives to continuously elevate your impact. Qualifications 3 - 5 years of experience in customer-facing roles such as customer success, account management, customer support, or client services (SaaS or retail technology experience strongly preferred) Proven track record of managing customer relationships, driving retention, and achieving customer satisfaction targets Strong interpersonal and communication skills with ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and navigate difficult conversations with empathy and professionalism Excellent problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills, able to diagnose issues, think critically, and deliver practical solutions under pressure Technical aptitude with ability to quickly learn software products, troubleshoot issues, and effectively demonstrate product features to diverse audiences Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple customer accounts, priorities, and projects concurrently without compromising quality Data-driven mindset, comfortable analysing customer usage data, identifying trends, and translating insights into actionable strategies Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented with strong sense of ownership and accountability for customer outcomes Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Communication, or related field (or equivalent work experience) About You You're genuinely customer-obsessed, you measure your success by your customers' success and take personal pride in their achievements You're a relationship builder who naturally earns trust, listens deeply, and makes customers feel heard, valued, and supported You're proactive and anticipatory, you don't wait for problems to escalate; you spot early warning signs and intervene before customers consider leaving You're commercially minded, you understand the business value of retention and expansion, and you're comfortable having revenue conversations with customers You're a problem-solver at heart, you stay calm under pressure, think critically, and find creative solutions to complex customer challenges You're organised and disciplined, you manage your book of business methodically, follow through on commitments, and never let important details slip through the cracks You're collaborative and team-oriented, you work seamlessly across departments to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve shared goals You're resilient and adaptable, you thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments and view challenges as opportunities to learn and grow What Success Looks Like Maintain >95% gross retention rate (GRR) across your customer portfolio, with proactive churn prevention strategies that keep customers engaged long-term Maintain >80% active rate across your customer portfolio Consistently identify and close upsell/cross-sell opportunities that drive 10-15% net revenue retention (NRR) growth annually within your accounts Drive measurable increases in feature adoption across your accounts, with customers actively using 4+ core Moniebook capabilities that maximise platform value Execute timely, friction-free renewals with 100% on-time contract completion and minimal escalations to leadership Your customers become promoters, willingly providing references, testimonials, case studies, and referrals that support sales and marketing efforts You regularly share customer insights that influence product decisions, contribute to CS process improvements, and mentor junior team members to elevate overall team performance What we can offer you Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning: We have a learning-and-development-focused environment, with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks. title: CRM Copy Writer
description: Who we are Ranked in 2023 and 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira’s worth in transactions monthly in the continent. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere. Our in-house creative agency plays a crucial role in defining and shaping our brand across multiple touchpoints, from digital and social media to video, print, and experiential marketing. About the role Location: Remote We are looking for an experienced CRM Copywriter to craft compelling, conversion-driven messaging for our email, SMS, in-app, push notifications, and lifecycle marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate is a storyteller and strategist who understands how to write persuasive, engaging, and data-informed copy that strengthens customer relationships and drives retention. As a CRM Copywriter, you will be responsible for writing high-performing customer lifecycle communications that engage, educate, and retain Moniepoint users. You will collaborate closely with the CRM strategist, Head of CRM, and CRM Designers to develop messaging strategies for different audience segments and CRM platforms. This role will focus on enhancing engagement across all CRM touchpoints, ensuring that every message adds value and strengthens brand loyalty. What you’ll get to do; Write compelling and targeted copy for CRM channels, including email, SMS, in-app messages, and push notifications. Develop customer lifecycle messaging for onboarding, engagement, retention, and reactivation campaigns. Craft transactional and automated messages that enhance the user experience. Tailor messaging for different customer personas and user segments. Collaborate with the Head of CRM to refine messaging strategies based on performance analytics. Continuously test subject lines, CTAs, and messaging structures to improve engagement and conversion rates. Analyze open rates, click-through rates, and customer response data to refine copy effectiveness. Stay updated on email deliverability best practices, spam filters, and mobile-friendly formatting. Ensure all messaging aligns with Moniepoint’s brand voice, tone, and personality. Balance creativity with clarity, ensuring messages are engaging, informative, and action-driven. Work closely with CRM, designers, product team, and customer support teams to align messaging with overall marketing goals. Provide copy direction for visual assets in CRM campaigns.
